46 & Fabulous! One Month After a Face & Neck Lift

One of my favorite Korean celebrities, renowned choreographer Bae Yoon jung, recently shared her incredibly honest recovery journey following a facelift and neck lift at the age of 46.
From significant swelling on day one to a beautifully defined jawline and a smoother neck just four weeks later, she openly documented every stage of her recovery.
She even expressed that she wished she had done it sooner!
Working in plastic surgery, I truly appreciate celebrities who openly share their experiences like this. It’s a wonderful reminder that healing takes time, patience, and trust in the process.
One month is still early in the healing journey, and results can continue to improve over the following months.
I love her honesty, confidence, and authenticity! ❤️
Everyone heals differently, and individual results may vary.

Having Plastic Surgery Soon?
Let's Talk Protein Drinks.
What I recommend to my recovery patients🥤

One thing I notice with my patients is how easy it is to overlook nutrition when you're busy preparing for surgery.
And after surgery? Your appetite may not be great, especially during those first few days.
But your body still needs adequate protein to support tissue repair and healing.
That's why I often discuss convenient nutritional options with my clients.

🥤 Fairlife Core Power & Quest: Easy ways to supplement daily protein intake when meals aren't providing enough.

🥤 Arginaid: A specialized supplement containing arginine, an amino acid involved in wound healing. It's not a replacement for a complete protein shake.

🥤 Juven & Pro-Stat: Other nutritional supplements I sometimes discuss, depending on individual needs.

⚠️ One important reminder: Not every protein drink is appropriate right before surgery. Some contain added supplements, including fish oil or vitamin E, that your surgeon may want you to avoid.

Many surgical practices recommend stopping certain supplements about two weeks before surgery, so always review ingredients and follow your surgeon's specific instructions.
And remember, you don't need all these products! The goal is adequate nutrition, not buying more supplements.
Whether you're preparing for a facelift, tummy tuck, breast surgery, or another plastic surgery procedure, paying attention to your protein intake is an important part of preparation.

🤍 Save this for your surgery prep list!

Have you tried any of these protein drinks?

Day 42 Facelift Recovery - Why Am I Spitting Stitches?

I’ve been spitting stitches in my lip lift incision and possibly at the outer corners of my eyes. I started noticing small red, tender bumps forming and wondered what was going on.

It turns out this can happen when dissolvable stitches slowly work their way to the surface. It’s a common part of healing and can appear weeks or even months after surgery. Most of the time, they resolve on their own once the stitch dissolves or comes out.

Facial Lift • Facial Rejuvenation • Jawline | 47-year-old — I Wanted My Appearance to Reflect My Confidence.

At 47, professional experience, confidence, and ambition don’t simply fade with age. Yet changes in facial contours can sometimes make a man appear more tired than he actually feels.

In business meetings, professional interactions, and everyday life, looking refreshed and feeling comfortable with your appearance can be personally meaningful.

For this 47-year-old patient, the goal was to restore facial definition while preserving his masculine character.

My preoperative assessment focused on:

• Reduced midface structural support
• Descending cheek tissues
• Deepening nasolabial folds
• Lower facial heaviness and early jowls
• Loss of jawline definition
• Fullness beneath the chin

With my patented Tri-Vector Lift™ technique, I focus on repositioning descended tissues, restoring structural support, and refining facial contours while respecting masculine proportions.

Male facial rejuvenation requires a different aesthetic approach. The goal is not excessive tightening, but balanced definition, natural angularity, and preservation of individual character.

His early postoperative changes reveal a more defined jawline, improved cheek contours, and a cleaner chin-to-neck transition.

At 47, the goal isn’t to compete with younger men. It’s to feel comfortable with the person you’ve worked so hard to become.

I’m Dr. Ye. Every face ages differently, and every treatment plan should reflect the patient’s anatomy, degree of aging, and personal expectations.

Contact my team on WhatsApp for a complimentary facial assessment and personalized lifting plan.

✨ “Years cannot be erased, but we can bring back the poised softness we once owned.”
That was exactly what she hoped to achieve.

She refused exaggerated changes that would overwrite her original facial features.
As a homemaker based in Germany, years of busy family life and long days of caregiving gradually left its mark on her face.

Slowly, the supporting structure of mid-face began to weaken.
The lower face gained weight and started to droop.
Her jawline lost its crisp definition, the boundary between face and neck turned blurred.

Her expectation was simple:
“I do not wish to become a different person.
I just want to restore light, balanced facial contours, while keeping my mature and distinctive character.”

After one-on-one facial evaluation, we created her exclusive ARC-Refine Lift™ solution, designed for her bone framework, soft-tissue condition and unique facial traits.

√ Rebuild the three-dimensional arch support of mid-face
√ Integrally reposition the sagging fascial soft tissue
√ Alleviate the heavy, droopy feeling of the lower face
√ Refine jawline and sharpen the transition from face to neck
√ Safeguard her natural facial identity and authentic expressions

Our goal is never to craft an unfamiliar new face.
It is to recover the elegant, well-balanced silhouette that belongs to her.

No unnaturally stretched tight look.
No excessive artificial correction.
No loss of her own unique facial character.

People notice the uplifting glow on her face.
Yet they cannot quite tell exactly what has been done.❤️
